what: Each screen-height section keeps its photo fixed to the screen (position: fixed) and shows it only inside its own cell with clip-path: inset(0) — on scroll the next section’s photo rises from below like a curtain and covers the previous photo, while the photo itself does not move. CSS only, no script

options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Pinned photo (required) — other text in the section sits on top of it

use: Your title here

from.where: about.css .ab-feature__item — original .about03__item: min-height 100vh·clip-path inset(0), photo position fixed·z-index -1·height 100vh

note: clip-path clips the painting of a fixed child to its own box. If an ancestor has transform or filter, fixed becomes relative to that ancestor and the curtain breaks
